subject: Inspection ops: evidence queue, pen-test window & owner matrix
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@healthgrid.com>
To: soojin_lee
Cc: procurement@healthgrid.com, Jake Turner <jake.turner@healthgrid.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Security exhibit redlines + evidence cadence (initial)

Soojin —

Thanks for taking this on. We need to close out MSA and the Order Form for our Q1 rollout; legal flagged the security exhibit and we want to align on two things quickly: the SOC 2 evidence cadence and the pen-test window.

Attached is our initial evidence matrix (evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx) that maps SOC 2 assertions to the artifacts we expect. High level asks: weekly evidence snapshots for 8 weeks during onboarding, and a limited-scope pen-test in late Jan (2-week window) with results and mitigations shared within 7 business days.

Two specific questions for Redwood:
- Can you confirm Redwood will provide SOC 2 Type II report and an owner for evidence handoffs?
- Is a limited scoped pen-test (no production compromise, staging access only) acceptable, and can you commit to the 7-business-day mitigation timeline?

If you can propose internal owners and a short cadence for evidence exchange, we can loop procurement and legal to lock the order form.

Thanks —
Elena Morales
Head of Technical Procurement
HealthGrid

Attachments: evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: soojin_lee

Elena —

Thanks, and appreciate the clear matrix. Quick answers up front: we will provide our latest SOC 2 Type II report and designate an evidence owner. The pen-test on staging only is acceptable; Redwood can support a 2-week window in late Jan and commit to a 7-business-day remediation delivery for agreed critical/high items.

Proposed internal owners (for handoffs and evidence requests):
- Evidence lead / weekly snapshot: Vanessa Ortiz (Security Ops)
- Pen-test coordination & staging access: Neha Kapoor (SecOps Eng)
- Contract / legal redline owner: Karthik Iyer (Legal)

I'll attach our redlines for the security exhibit and an initial proposed evidence cadence: weekly compressed snapshots (PDF) + one handoff meeting every 2 weeks during the first 8-week onboarding period. See attached: redlines_v3.docx (highlights in-line).

Would Monday 12/6 at 10am PT work for a 30-minute alignment call with procurement?

— Soojin
So helpfully, Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer
To: vanessa_ortiz, soojin_lee
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@healthgrid.com>, procurement@healthgrid.com
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2027 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security exhibit redlines + evidence cadence (legal redlines)

Vanessa/Soojin —

I reviewed HealthGrid's matrix and marked up the security exhibit. A few legal points we need to resolve before we can accept the language in the Order Form:

1) Audit rights scope: we can accommodate SOC 2 and a limited pen-test on staging, but we need the clause to require advance notice (48 hours) and a mutually-agreed statement of work. We cannot accept open-ended onsite inspection rights. Please ask HealthGrid to accept the proposed wording in redlines_v3.docx (see §3.2).

2) Data access & minimization: any evidence pulled from production must be anonymized or redacted; we will provide token-level logs and aggregated counters where possible.

3) Findings timeline: the 7-business-day turnaround is acceptable only for critical findings if testing scope is agreed. For lower-severity issues, we need 21 days to respond. Suggest we spell severity buckets into the exhibit.

4) Proof of SOC 2: we will provide our latest Type II report and a signed letter attesting to its scope. We ask HealthGrid to treat the report as confidential.

If HealthGrid accepts the SOW-limited pen-test and the severity-bucket response timeline, I can sign off on the redlines and we can move the Order Form to DocuSign.

On process: please confirm owners for each evidence row in the matrix (I included a new "owner" column in the attached file). Also, Vanessa — can you confirm what logs we can reasonably share for the weekly snapshot?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redlines_v3.docx (docx)

From: Elena Morales <elena@healthgrid.com>
To: soojin_lee, vanessa_ortiz, karthik_iyer
Cc: procurement@healthgrid.com, Jake Turner <jake.turner@healthgrid.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Dec 2027 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security exhibit redlines + evidence cadence (legal redlines)

Thanks Karthik — that framework is reasonable. A couple follow ups from HealthGrid:

- We are fine with a mutually-agreed SOW and 48-hour notice for the pen-test. We will formalize testing boundaries in pen-test-scope.pdf. Can you confirm whether Redwood can grant time-limited staging credentials and IP allowlists?

- Severity buckets: we can accept 7 business days for critical, 14 days for high, 30 for medium/low. We can live with the confidentiality note on SOC 2 — procurement will store the report in our secure vault.

- Owners: we will populate the owner column and return the matrix by EOD Monday 12/6.

On the DocuSign path: procurement will prefer a short window to sign once redlines are final.

On staging access: Jake can coordinate the IP range we will use for the test.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Elena

Attachments: pen-test-scope.pdf (pdf)

Subject: Re: Security exhibit redlines + evidence cadence — action items and next steps

Elena / team —

Appreciate the fast replies. Confirming decisions and owners so we can move to the Order Form:

Summary of agreed items:
- SOC 2: Redwood will deliver the latest SOC 2 Type II report and a signed attestation. HealthGrid will treat the report as confidential. (Owner: Karthik for delivery; copy to procurement)
- Evidence cadence: weekly compressed snapshots + biweekly sync for first 8 weeks of onboarding. (Owner: Vanessa Ortiz)
- Pen-test: mutually-signed SOW on staging-only testing; 2-week window in Jan (we propose Jan 17–31). Time-limited staging credentials and IP allowlisting: Redwood can provide these. Findings turnaround: critical = 7 business days; high = 14; medium/low = 30. (Owner: Neha Kapoor)
- Audit rights: limited to SOC 2 review and SOW-defined pen-test only; no open onsite inspection rights. HealthGrid to accept proposed §3.2 language in redlines_v3.docx. (Owner: Karthik Iyer)

Action items (owners & dates):
- HealthGrid to return the matrix with owner assignments by EOD Monday 2027-12-06. (Owner: Elena / Jake)
- Karthik to finalize redline language for §3.2 and circulate a final draft by Tue 2027-12-07. (Owner: Karthik)
- Vanessa to confirm log types we can share in the weekly snapshot and publish a short sample list by Wed 2027-12-08. (Owner: Vanessa)
- Neha to prepare staging access checklist and IP allowlist template; target completion Thu 2027-12-10. (Owner: Neha)

Once HealthGrid returns the populated matrix and Karthik finalizes the small clause edits, we will route the Order Form to DocuSign. Please use the HubSpot deal link for tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4321.

Let me know if you'd like a short alignment call Monday 12/6 10am PT — otherwise we'll proceed asynchronously.

— Soojin
